data.exact_reserve_text: The loss on the technical account of GBP 23.6m (2016: profit GBP 21.4m) includes a run-off deficit of GBP 8.0m for prior accident years (2016: GBP 21.5m surplus). data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2017 Syndicate 1414 reported gross claims outstanding at the prior year (closing 2016) of GBP 553.084m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 9.15m (1.66% of opening reserves), driven primarily by adverse development in older accident years (notably the 2015 accident year) and large-loss development, partially associated with reinsurance acceptance business. The managing agent also states a run-off deficit for prior accident years and specifically cites a deficit on reinsurance acceptance business partially offset by a small surplus on direct business. The 2017 catastrophe activity (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria and California wildfires) led to Industry Loss Warranty recoveries and increased funding requirements but these are current-year items.
raw_causal_phrases: includes a run-off deficit of GBP 8.0m for prior accident years (2016: GBP 21.5m surplus).
This included a deficit of GBP 8.8m for reinsurance acceptance business and a surplus of GBP 0.8m on direct business

Note that net paid claims on the 2017 year are positive due to large recoveries on a number of Industry Loss Warranties which became payable as a result of Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and the California wildfires.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross amounts shown in the notes). The managing agent narrative reports a run-off deficit of GBP 8.0m for prior accident years and specific deficits/surpluses by business (reinsurance acceptance deficit GBP 8.8m, direct business surplus GBP 0.8m) but does not explicitly label those figures as gross vs net; the triangle-derived gross PYD is +GBP 9.151m (strengthening). No RITC distortion was identified. Opening reserves taken from the balance sheet gross 'Claims outstanding' prior-year comparative column.
